subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He is an absolutely ______ man.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'Chaste'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct word** to fill in the blank in the sentence* "He is an absolutely ______ man."* is:** 'Chaste'.**
 
• In English, **"chaste"** is an adjective that refers to someone who is morally clean and pure, particularly in a sexual context.
 
• It can also be used more generally to describe something that is simple, restrained, and devoid of unnecessary ornamentation.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is:* 'He is an absolutely **chaste **man.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options don't fit:
 
 
• **Chased: **The past participle of "chase", typically refers to having pursued in order to catch or catch up with. It wouldn't make sense in the given sentence.
 
• **Chest: **This is a noun that refers to the front part of the body between the neck and the abdomen, or a large strong box, typically made of wood and used for storage or shipping. It doesn't fit grammatically or semantically in the sentence.
 
• **Crazed: **This is an adjective that can describe a person who is wildly insane or mad. Though grammatically correct, it conveys a very different meaning from "chaste" and doesn't fit with the word "absolutely" as well as "chaste" does.
